q1_issues.issue: The flat conjunct (Member (sk_vessels $x) full) predicates the state of the GROUP symbol, the reading the plural rules explicitly bar ("a member state never rides the group symbol ... never (Member <group> <state>)") — each vessel is full, not the collection, so this half owes a per-member distribution over (PartOf $y (sk_vessels $x)).

For the same reason the reified state takes the group as its bearer, (Experiencer (sk_full $x) (sk_vessels $x)) with (Of (sk_full $x) mire_essence), asserting one collective fullness-of-mire-essence rather than the per-member Skolem state the group case calls for.

notes: Everything else is per doctrine: the adjectivally-restricted bare-plural subject becomes a premise conjunct, the inanimate transitive subject stays Agent, "several vessels" is a per-binding Skolem group with CardinalityPhrase, and mire_essence carries its genus with the noun modifier unexposed. The group-bearer case sits at the seam of two sections — the adjective-PP-complement reification and the group-distribution bar — with the worked per-member state form given only under Resultatives.
